baseline_change: The preceding refund-review and shared-cache iterations were committed before starting this iteration. That commit has not been pushed.
selected_problem: A served session with only a persisted FAILED assistant reply still has containment=100% under the documented no-ticket/no-downvote proxy, with no independent failed-population visibility.

contract.sessions_with_failed_replies: Distinct sessions with >=1 in-window assistant FAILED row.
contract.sessions_with_completed_replies: Distinct sessions with >=1 in-window assistant COMPLETED row; completion is a reply record state, not a resolution verdict.
contract.sessions_latest_reply_failed: Distinct sessions whose newest in-window assistant row, ordered by created_at DESC then id DESC, is FAILED.
contract.overlap: A FAILED then COMPLETED session belongs to both occurrence cohorts but latest_failed is0. The reverse ordering has latest_failed1. Pending/processing/unknown latest rows do not count as completed or latest_failed.
contract.not_added: This iteration does not add a strict all-replies-failed cohort or row-count metrics; those were initial audit alternatives, not the selected contract.

exporter_and_dashboard.scope: Exporter and static Grafana dashboard contract; mocked repository results through real refresh function and Prometheus registry. SQL aggregation and actual JWT route are validated separately by parent/evaluation agent.

semantics.new_counts: Window-level distinct sessions; failed and completed counts can overlap. Latest-reply failure follows latest assistant within configured window, not later user messages.
semantics.undefined_rate: Keep old rate gauge value, but dashboard filters each replica using both served>0 and successful-refresh timestamp>0 before avg.
semantics.staleness: DB errors retain all old values and last-success timestamp. Successful zero traffic clears absolute counts and advances timestamp.
semantics.publication: All required repository fields resolved before gauge writes; successful timestamp set last. This does not promise an atomic SQL or scrape snapshot.
semantics.replicas: Count/rate panels retain avg strategy over successfully initialized replicas; age uses max timestamp for most recent successful replica, not evidence every replica is fresh.

exporter_and_dashboard.promql_validation: Official primary docs confirm comparison filters and set-intersection preserves left values; static tests require the chosen expressions and exported metric inventory. No Prometheus engine/promtool execution claimed.
limits: No production DB or SQL snapshot claim.
No production Grafana browser rendering or PromQL execution.
No summation of per-replica DB counts; independent/frozen replica observations may disagree.

before.scope: Fresh isolated process before initialization-gating change; no repository query or refresh performed.
before.finding: Uninitialized exporter gauges are0 and last_success_timestamp is0. Ungated avg(count) displays0 before any successful refresh and averages an uninitialized replica into a valid count.
before.limits: Numeric two-replica example applies official PromQL and/comparison filtering semantics; this process did not execute PromQL.

initialization_guard.semantics: Each count/rate series is filtered against that replica last-success timestamp>0 before avg. Rate also requires served>0. No bool modifier is used, so timestamp comparison drops uninitialized series while and preserves the count/rate value. A successful zero count remains0; an all-uninitialized deployment has no resulting series. Previously successful but stale replicas remain included by existing policy.
initialization_guard.limits: PromQL filtering follows official semantics; no Prometheus execution, browser render or all-replica freshness claim. Exporter code and alert rules were not changed for this follow-up.

final_dashboard_panels.title: 自动处理率（会话级代理）
final_dashboard_panels.description: 配置滚动窗口内服务过的会话（≥1条 assistant 消息，包含失败回复）中无转人工工单且无差评的占比；没有工单或差评并不构成问题解决证据。窗口由 CONTAINMENT_STATS_WINDOW_DAYS 配置，默认7天，不随 Grafana 时间选择器改变。DB Gauge 周期刷新，错误保留旧值；逐副本以 served>0 且成功刷新时间戳>0 过滤后取 avg；无流量或尚未成功初始化时不显示旧率。配合刷新年龄面板识别陈旧值；各副本可能错时刷新，不保证同一数据库快照。

final_dashboard_panels.title: 服务与转人工会话数
final_dashboard_panels.description: 统计窗口由 CONTAINMENT_STATS_WINDOW_DAYS 配置（默认7天），不是 Grafana 选定时间范围。各副本查询同一数据库，延续 avg 聚合策略避免副本重复相加；副本可能错时刷新或保留旧值。 served含窗口内任何 assistant 回复；escalated为其中存在人工工单的会话。 仅纳入成功刷新时间戳>0的副本；全部尚未成功刷新时无数据，已成功刷新的零流量仍显示0。

final_dashboard_panels.title: 出现失败回复的会话数
final_dashboard_panels.description: 统计窗口由 CONTAINMENT_STATS_WINDOW_DAYS 配置（默认7天），不是 Grafana 选定时间范围。各副本查询同一数据库，延续 avg 聚合策略避免副本重复相加；副本可能错时刷新或保留旧值。 窗口内至少一条 assistant FAILED；与完成回复会话数可重叠，同一会话仅计一次。 仅纳入成功刷新时间戳>0的副本；全部尚未成功刷新时无数据，已成功刷新的零流量仍显示0。

final_dashboard_panels.title: 出现完成回复的会话数
final_dashboard_panels.description: 统计窗口由 CONTAINMENT_STATS_WINDOW_DAYS 配置（默认7天），不是 Grafana 选定时间范围。各副本查询同一数据库，延续 avg 聚合策略避免副本重复相加；副本可能错时刷新或保留旧值。 窗口内至少一条 assistant COMPLETED；技术状态完成不是问题解决证据，且可与失败会话重叠。 仅纳入成功刷新时间戳>0的副本；全部尚未成功刷新时无数据，已成功刷新的零流量仍显示0。

final_dashboard_panels.title: 最新回复失败的会话数
final_dashboard_panels.description: 统计窗口由 CONTAINMENT_STATS_WINDOW_DAYS 配置（默认7天），不是 Grafana 选定时间范围。各副本查询同一数据库，延续 avg 聚合策略避免副本重复相加；副本可能错时刷新或保留旧值。 只看窗口内最新 assistant，按 created_at DESC、id DESC 排序；后续 user 消息不改变这个状态。 仅纳入成功刷新时间戳>0的副本；全部尚未成功刷新时无数据，已成功刷新的零流量仍显示0。

final_dashboard_panels.title: 最近成功刷新距今（秒）
final_dashboard_panels.description: 取各副本成功刷新时间戳的 max，显示最近成功副本距今秒数；不代表全部副本均新鲜。尚未有成功刷新时不显示数据。数据库错误保留旧时间戳，成功刷新即使零流量也更新时间；系统时间偏差会影响年龄。

verification.post_full_changes: Only Grafana JSON expressions and its existing contract assertions changed after the full suite. Application code is unchanged; the 19-test exporter/dashboard suite was rerun successfully for the final initialization filter. Test case count is unchanged.

limits: This is persisted-message status visibility, not a customer resolution rate or proof that a session with any failure is unresolved.
No production database, PostgreSQL native-enum migration/concurrency test, Prometheus server scrape, live Grafana/browser validation or deployment was performed.
Dashboard evidence is configuration only; the independent exporter owner tests its expressions and last-success timestamp policy.
The new aggregate and the older aggregate statements are not claimed to form a fixed snapshot under concurrent database writes.
Metrics classify persisted assistant-row processing status. A zero-token or unpersisted failure remains outside these cohorts and needs separate stream/request telemetry.
The failed/completed cohorts overlap; latest failed is neither customer-resolution evidence nor a global current service-error rate.
The new three cohorts share one SQL aggregate; the overall report still has seven statements and is not a fixed snapshot under concurrent writes.
The independent SQLite query-count probe proves constant statement count, not database capacity or latency.
A read-only Docker probe found the daemon unavailable. PostgreSQL was compiled but not executed; no production DB, Prometheus query engine, live Grafana/browser, remote CI or deployment was used.
Dashboard replica averages are not sums and may mix refresh instants; freshness age is for the most recently successful replica, not all replicas.
Existing alert rules were not changed by this iteration.
This evidence was captured before committing; the user subsequently requested a commit. Local Compose overrides and working planning notes are kept local.
